summary: Bolt Biotherapeutics filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting an October 1, 2026 Second Amendment to its Chesapeake Drive master lease with landlord HCP LS Redwood City LLC. The company paid $1.0 million and conceded the landlord's right to draw the full $1.5 million letter of credit, while the lease term was accelerated to December 31, 2027, or earlier upon a financing or strategic Corporate Transaction. A further $4.5 million termination payment would be due on such a closing. This is an ordinary lease renegotiation, not a special situation, though the strategic-transaction trigger is worth monitoring.
